SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference_from_overall, difference_from_overall - regional_avg_difference AS excess_over_region_avg
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference_from_overall,
         AVG(difference_from_overall) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS regional_avg_difference
  FROM (
    SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           COUNT(*) - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id, (SELECT A3 FROM district WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM account WHERE account_id = o.account_id)))) AS difference_from_overall
    FROM `order` AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
  )
)
WHERE difference_from_overall > regional_avg_difference
ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
